message:
release: 0.2.155 (PC) and APK 0.2.27 -- picking a monitor on the phone works; a screen that goes away falls back

monitor-fallback (t-970r4zgo, 36b2b04): the APK's monitor pick never got the answer its decoder gate waits for,
so every pick timed out (no field success in any NAS log; Home PC with two screens, 2026-10-09). The host now
advertises 0x8 and answers a monitor pick through the window-select transaction (marker 0x7000000000000000|id,
answered after the restart commits, rolled back on failure, stale-session safe); an APK on an older host says the
host needs updating. A picked screen that disappears now falls back to the primary instead of retrying forever.
Also merged: udp-recv-exit (t-d7gyiu3g, ..ec97851) -- the PC viewer's UDP ingress treats WSAECONNRESET as advisory;
the shared client (the APK) keeps an empty datagram from ending the session and bounds drop diagnostics; and
udp-recv-nonblock (t-009c7942, 35d5937) -- the Windows shared client (test harness only; GNLinkViewer does not
build it) reads through a bounded readiness wait instead of a blocking recv that returned 997. Plus the
stutter-keyframe test follow-ups (974c3a8, 89313e3: the r6-reproduction seam compiled only into its test).
Verified: Codex SOURCE OK on each piece and INTEGRATION SOURCE OK on 7a8d277; verifier's independent Release builds
(monitor e2e 173/0 x6, fec no-premature-NACK, build gate 32/0, no test strings in the shipped GNLinkStream) and the
main integration build 26/26 at 35d5937; APK assembleDebug + JVM on the integrated tree.
Not verified: a real phone/tablet picking a monitor (MediaCodec), a real screen hot-unplug; the cause of the
earlier field disconnects stays unknown (997 was a Windows test-harness path, not the APK).

Product: version only (PC 0.2.154 -> 0.2.155; APK 0.2.26 -> 0.2.27, versionCode 25 -> 26). Test: none. Docs: none.
